the-secret-of-the-old-library.title: The Secret of the Old Library
the-secret-of-the-old-library.author: Unknown Author
the-secret-of-the-old-library.description: For twelve-year-old Nora, the 112-year-old Willowbrook Library is the best place in the world. So when the town council decides to close it, she is determined to find a way to save it. Hidden in a dusty cabinet, she discovers the diary of the library's founder and a mysterious letter that leads to a secret behind the old fireplace. A charming mystery about books, history, and how one young reader can bring a whole community together.

the-comet-club.title: The Comet Club
the-comet-club.author: Unknown Author
the-comet-club.description: Ava spends her nights stargazing on the garage roof with her late mother's old telescope, but she has never told anyone at school. When a new teacher starts an astronomy club, Ava joins three other curious students, and together they take part in a real science program searching for unknown objects in space. Through patience, teamwork, and friendship, the Comet Club makes a discovery that changes everything. An inspiring story about science, perseverance, and the stars that connect us to the people we love.

the-turtle-beach-rescue.title: The Turtle Beach Rescue
the-turtle-beach-rescue.author: Unknown Author
the-turtle-beach-rescue.description: During his summer vacation at Coral Bay, eleven-year-old Noah discovers mysterious tracks in the sand that lead to a sea turtle nest. He becomes the youngest volunteer with a marine biologist protecting the eggs, but bright lights from a new beach house threaten to lead the baby turtles in the wrong direction. With a heartfelt letter and a new friend, Noah sets out to help the hatchlings find their way to the ocean. A gentle and hopeful story about nature, conservation, and how one young person can make a difference.

the-lighthouse-on-gull-island.title: The Lighthouse on Gull Island
the-lighthouse-on-gull-island.author: Unknown Author
the-lighthouse-on-gull-island.description: Fourteen-year-old Maya is sent to spend the summer with her grandfather on a tiny island with no internet and nothing to do. But when she helps him restore the old lighthouse for the island's 200th birthday, she discovers the meaning of a promise. And when a storm cuts the power and a fishing boat is lost at sea, Maya must climb 112 steps and keep the light shining with her own two hands. A heartwarming story about family, courage, and finding where you belong.

the-mountain-trail-challenge.title: The Mountain Trail Challenge
the-mountain-trail-challenge.author: Unknown Author
the-mountain-trail-challenge.description: Jordan is terrified of heights, but his eighth-grade class trip is a six-mile hike to the top of Eagle Peak. His team includes a fast runner who always wants to be first, a quiet bird lover, and a girl recovering from a broken ankle. When they reach the narrow mountain ridge, Jordan must face his biggest fear, and he learns that the hardest climbs are easier when you have friends beside you. An encouraging story about courage, empathy, and teamwork.

the-robot-who-planted-sunflowers.title: The Robot Who Planted Sunflowers
the-robot-who-planted-sunflowers.author: Unknown Author
the-robot-who-planted-sunflowers.description: Oliver is the smartest kid in seventh grade, and he believes he works best alone. So when he is placed on a science fair team with a quiet gardener and the class clown, he expects disaster. But as the three of them build a solar-powered robot to save their dying school garden, Oliver learns that brilliant ideas grow best when they are shared. A funny and uplifting story about teamwork, friendship, and the surprising power of working together.

the-bakery-on-cherry-lane.title: The Bakery on Cherry Lane
the-bakery-on-cherry-lane.author: Unknown Author
the-bakery-on-cherry-lane.description: Thirteen-year-old Sofia loves baking, so when the beloved Cherry Lane Bakery puts up a "Help Wanted" sign, she becomes the apprentice of kind old Mr. Rossi. But when rising rent threatens to close the shop forever, Sofia enters a city baking contest with a secret family recipe from Italy. A sweet and heartwarming story about hard work, tradition, and a neighborhood coming together to save something special.
